name: Derive the Trotter error bound for simulating H = sum_j H_j ...
question: Derive the Trotter error bound for simulating H = sum_j H_j using the first-order Lie-Trotter formula. Show that the error of the product formula of n steps over total time t is O(t^2 / n), and explain how second-order Trotter-Suzuki improves this.
